versions.changelog: v1.0.2: Fix three hidden bugs - geometry formula (cy=y_top), transparent facecolor=none, self_check dual-dim check (alpha>128 AND RGB_max<200)

v1.0.1: Sanitized text examples in SKILL.md and script (replaced specific Chinese phrases with generic placeholders). All other capabilities unchanged from v1.0.0: upper-arc CJK text rendering for packaging/seals/banners, kai/song/hei fonts, transparent + white-bg preview output, strong-pixel self-check, date+version filename convention.

Initial release. Generate upper-arc Chinese text icons for outer packaging, seals, banners. Includes: corrected polar geometry (sin for x, cos for y), CJK fonts (kai/song/hei), spacing safety check, strong-pixel self-check, and date+version filename convention. Origin: HVDC Veterans Affairs greeting label v1-v32 iteration.
